tools.name: list_businesses
tools.description: List a bounded page of safe business metadata for the authenticated InvoiceVista organization. Addresses, contact details, payment settings, and secrets are omitted.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get safe metadata for one business owned by the authenticated InvoiceVista organization. Contact, legal-entity, address, banking, and integration fields are omitted.

tools.name: get_revenue_summary
tools.description: Summarize invoice production and recorded payments for one tenant-owned business over at most 366 UTC days. Returns aggregate counts and amounts only—never invoice, payment, customer, line-item, processor, card, bank, note, or identifier data. It cannot execute or advise on a financial transaction.

tools.name: get_receivables_summary
tools.description: Summarize open, overdue, and age-bucketed receivables for one tenant-owned business. Returns aggregate counts and amounts only; partially paid invoices are excluded from money totals because InvoiceVista does not store their remaining balance. Never returns invoice/customer identifiers, exact dates,

tools.name: get_quote_pipeline_summary
tools.description: Summarize non-draft quote counts, values, and status mix for one tenant-owned business over at most 366 UTC days. Returns aggregates only—never quote/customer identifiers, contacts, tax ids, addresses, notes, line descriptions, or arbitrary free text.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List a bounded page of safe product catalog metadata for the authenticated organization.

tools.name: get_subscription
tools.description: Get the current billing plan and quota limits for one tenant-owned business. Falls back to the Free tier when the business has no active or past-due subscription. Payment-processor identifiers and credentials are never returned.

tools.name: show_business_overview
tools.description: Render a bounded tenant-owned business snapshot with aggregate customer, invoice, payment, quote, and product counts plus a product-catalog preview. Never returns individual customer or financial records, identifiers, numbers, exact dates/amounts, contacts, tax ids, addresses, notes, line descriptio

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_businesses" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
